Why our websites work

Three jobs. Every single page. In this order.

Most agencies hand you a brochure and call it a website. We build every page to do three jobs — because a site that isn’t found, doesn’t convert, and doesn’t generate enquiries isn’t an asset. It’s a bill.

01

Visibility

Built to be found from day one — in Google and in AI answers. Schema, clean technical structure and SEO content are baked into the build, not bolted on later.

02

Conversion

Every layout decision is a conversion decision. We design the path from landing to enquiry during the build, so visitors actually pick up the phone or fill in the form.

03

Leads

Success isn’t launch day — it’s the enquiry that lands next Tuesday. We build, track and measure for one outcome: more qualified leads for your business.

The Nifty difference

Every website ships with a $2,000 SEO build, free.

Other agencies charge thousands for search visibility, or leave you to work it out. We build it into every website as standard, so you launch ready to rank, not waiting for a phase-two invoice.

How it works

A simple path from brief to launch.

No jargon and no endless back-and-forth. One point of contact from start to finish, and a first draft fast: within 48 hours on Starter, or 5 working days on Professional.

1. The brief

First we work out what you want and who you are targeting. We get clear on your goals and your customers before anything is designed.

2. Concept for approval

We build a design concept from that brief and send it to you for approval, so you shape the direction before the rest of the build continues.

3. Build + free SEO

Once you approve the concept, we complete the build and bake in the $2,000 SEO package, content, schema, speed and tracking, all included.

4. Go live

We launch, connect your analytics, and hand over a finished website. Done and dusted, and working for you.

Built for your industry

Websites that speak your trade, and get quoted by AI.

Our industry pages are already cited in Google’s AI Overviews. We build for how your customers actually search and buy, and for how AI engines quote you.

Platform & hosting

Built fast. Hosted safe.

Your Starter or Professional website is built on the Nifty platform as a lightning-fast site with no database or plugins to slow it down or be hacked. You edit it yourself, anytime, in the Nifty Dashboard Builder.

Lightning fast

Every page is pre-built and served ready to go, with no database to slow it down. Your site loads in a blink.

Global edge hosting

Served from a global edge network spanning hundreds of cities, so your site is just as fast for every visitor, wherever they are.

Secure by design

Free SSL and DDoS protection come standard, and with no database or plugins there is nothing for hackers to exploit.

Invisible spam protection

Your forms are protected by invisible, privacy-friendly spam filtering, so real enquiries get through and bots do not.

Reliable form email

Every enquiry is delivered straight to your inbox through a dedicated transactional email account, included with your hosting.

Smart edge routing

Behind the scenes, smart edge routing powers your live editing, instant previews and reliable lead delivery.
